Our treatments

Your whole smile, in one place.

From a simple check-up to a full smile makeover, every treatment is explained before it starts.

Hygiene & scaling

Scaling, polishing and oral-hygiene coaching for healthy gums and fresh breath.

Fillings & cavities

Aesthetics & whitening

Whitening, veneers and touch-ups for a bright, natural smile.

Implants & crowns

Orthodontics & aligners

Oral hygiene

Prevention is the best treatment.

Scaling every 6 months and a good routine at home prevent most cavities and gum problems.

Your daily routine

  • Brush for 2 minutes, morning and night
  • Floss or use interdental brushes every night
  • Brush your tongue too
  • Limit sugar and soft drinks between meals
  • Scaling and check-up every 6 months

The clinic

A calm place, precise care.

Dr. Chraibi welcomes you in a bright, reassuring clinic in Saada. A simple approach: listen, explain, treat without pain.

Dr. Chraibi's dental clinic is located in Saada, Marrakech. It welcomes adults, children and visitors to Marrakech for everyday dental care, scaling and oral hygiene, whitening and smile aesthetics, implants and crowns, orthodontics with clear aligners, root canal treatment, extractions and dental emergencies. Consultations in Arabic, Darija, French and English, Monday to Friday 9am to 7pm and Saturday 9am to 1pm.

GentleSoft anaesthesia and precise care, even for anxious patients.
ListeningTime to understand your needs and answer your questions.
Strict hygieneSterilisation and single-use equipment for every patient.

What our patients say

FAQ

You may be wondering…

How do I book?

Tap “Book”, choose the treatment, day and time, then send your request on WhatsApp. The clinic confirms quickly.

Do you see emergencies?

Yes. For strong pain, an abscess or a broken tooth, choose “Dental emergency” or call the clinic directly.

How much does treatment cost?

It depends on your situation. After the exam, Dr. Chraibi gives you a clear quote before any treatment.

How often should I have a scaling?

Usually every 6 months, sometimes more often if your gums bleed or if you smoke.

Do you treat children?

Yes, from their very first teeth, with visits designed to put them at ease.

Which languages do you speak?

Arabic, Darija, French and English.

Where is Dr. Chraibi's dental clinic?

In Saada, Marrakech (Google Maps code MXGJ+7C). The “Directions” button opens the route in Google Maps.

Is the clinic open on Saturday?

Yes, on Saturday from 9am to 1pm. On weekdays, Monday to Friday from 9am to 7pm. Closed on Sunday.
